actualFailure: CpfServerSessionSecurityAutoConfiguration activated in a resource-server Generated Domain and required CPF_BFF_CREDENTIAL_KEY before DataSource/controller startup
diagnosis: The attempted CPF_BFF_CREDENTIAL_KEY environment name is not the Spring binding name of CpfServerSessionProperties. More importantly, the resource-server profile did not select the optional browser-session provider; dependency ownership must be traced instead of bypassing the boundary with a session secret.
